entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with support for User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses a custom vector graph engine and hybrid search to combine RAG and memory. It features automated fact extraction, context fencing, and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agent utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It supports scoped data access for multi-user company environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Docker, Kubernetes, or bare metal and provides clients for Python, Node.js, Go, and CLI.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library for building stateful agents provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted use. It offers hybrid search, prompt-ready context injection, and client SDKs for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and runs on local infrastructure including Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving context harness supports multiple providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, and local models. It provides Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces and generates filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a SQLite-backed message store and a hierarchical DAG to build depth-aware summary nodes. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub and reports a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable data locally. It features hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embedders and integrates with MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% in tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin includes recency ranking, contradiction tracking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments. It supports an in-process embedded mode by default and provides explainable retrieval via a why_retrieved tag.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores data as inspectable Markdown files to ensure memory ownership. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Codex and Claude Code.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It supports stdio or SSE MCP servers and requires no account.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent v0.14.0 tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in schema tokens.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports real, immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage memory without persistent summaries.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging via USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate automated payments for AI agents.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing by directing questions to entire artifacts instead of using chunk RAG. It registers five native tools for knowledge search, retrieval, and feedback.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It provides HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall with MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It enables grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid BM25, vector, and graph search methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic software development methodology utilizing subagent-driven development for autonomous task execution. It integrates with coding harnesses like Claude, Codex, and Cursor while enforcing TDD and YAGNI principles.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports the generation of web, mobile, and desktop prototypes on macOS and Windows. It includes CLI support for multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It is capable of building knowledge graphs from any data format and supports Rust and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains mapped to six industry frameworks. These skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for natural language diagram generation.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It integrates fragmented ecosystem layers through natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and escrow.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill deduplication and quality improvement to allow skills to evolve collectively. It synchronizes skill libraries across multiple devices and integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides spec-conformant Agent Plugins for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state in a docs/ folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,117 task-specific markdown files that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists via TranscriptAPI. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format and works with Hermes Agent and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation to manage and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains and reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency. It supports modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts, as well as remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository provides skills for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides prompting guides for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models along with API integration documentation. It offers a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned skills from code or documentation while providing provenance via file and line number citations. It supports both Node.js and Python environments.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses an Apache-2.0 specification to provide intent as code via a single Rust binary. It enables static auditing through nika check and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and provides incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a 5-layer approach involving hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by using three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It verifies findings through sandbox execution and uses a deterministic pre-scan with tools like Semgrep and Bandit.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation using the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses a local SQLite database with no cloud sync to manage habits and study blocks. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and allows user task completion via tapping.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It supports 97 languages and can reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses three parallel sub-agents—Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness—to perform multi-agent code simplification. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust through a tiered application process with an approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io features MCP integration and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides 2,077 total skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, using CVE-driven skills.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables searching through over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This project automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties, buying context, and creating boards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level reports. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and uses semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite provides video-to-text transcription, local OCR for PDFs and images, and batch e-commerce material generation. It is designed to handle tasks such as AI text de-humanization and brand overlays.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It ensures environment-specific path syntax and verifies project-compatible interpreters.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via a hosted MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 platforms. It includes five production-grade skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, and their associated development tools. It supports a variety of licensing models, including MIT, Apache-2.0, and unfree licenses, for integration into Nix-based environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It includes a gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and enables users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative configuration of Hermes Agent settings and workspace documents. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates secure secrets handling via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides monitoring tools for per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with distinct identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable production package that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, offering Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments for offline use.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and employs a researcher team to assess insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It supports frameworks such as CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for registry management, security auditing, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale agents into automated teams. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers and MCP tool integration. It features durable agent memory and visual org charts for delegating agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system provides a Kanban board and review queues to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work. It features live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage automated task lifecycles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TerminalBench-2 and TBLite while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for tool-calling and task routing without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a CLI interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, with options to submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, and other tools. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLIs and is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM/GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and undo functionality for recent agent changes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph, including memory tools for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram. It also offers a plugin for Claude Code featuring automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through token-saving CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations, skills, and memories. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents to manage project-specific instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic and local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It identifies issues such as conflicting output formats or unbounded retries and supports SARIF 2.1.0 and JSON output formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local, offline functionality with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with the Tauri 2 framework that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It manages configurations for Hermes Agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs. It supports remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, and includes assistants for generating editable PPT, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface that runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations and models. It features a three-panel layout with an integrated workspace file browser and is accessible via browser or mobile through secure SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for chat, sessions, and tools, and supports multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard that provides multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It features streaming responses, tool traces, visual workflow building, Kanban boards, and channel configuration for 10 platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It includes a full workspace file browser with Monaco and PTY terminal, and supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode as a desktop or self-hosted app. It allows users to delegate tasks to sub-agents using @ mentions and can run unattended tasks on separate git branches.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via direct local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, along with an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop app built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that also supports macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution and features a UI for MCP tools, memory management, and LaTeX/Mermaid rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser context to a local, Hermes Cloud, or remote API Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Web for full-page session management and site-aware drafting via Hermes Assist.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage agent sessions, tasks, and skills, while providing read-only access to memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw engines. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports 13 agent sources, including Hermes. It features image browsing, analytics, and one-click resume functionality for supported CLIs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: A TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It allows for real-time tracking of session activity and costs, as well as read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming. It includes a marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client for orchestrating collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
